# Siyahi — Full Site Context

Siyahi is the personal poetry archive of Saumitra S. Phatak. It contains 109 original poems in Hindi, Marathi, and English, plus 33 short aphorisms. The title means “ink” in Hindi and Urdu.

## Reading model

The main page is an archive rather than one continuous book. Readers can:

- switch among Hindi, Marathi, and English
- search titles, poem text, subtitles, and meanings
- filter by theme
- open a focused reader
- move to the previous or next filtered poem
- reveal or hide explanatory meanings
- share a direct hash link to a poem
- choose a random poem

The original scrolling book remains at `/book.html`.

## Language notes

Language labels overlap. “Bhai” is intentionally present in Hindi, Marathi, and English. “Wyaparatil Bhav” is present in Hindi and Marathi. English poems written earlier in the collection are included in the English tab rather than being restricted to the final English chapter.

## Theme ranges

| Poems | Theme |
|---|---|
| 1–44 | Ishq — love and longing |
| 45–52 | Dosti — friendship |
| 53–55 | Rishtey — family and bonds |
| 56–93 | Zindagi — life and philosophy |
| 94–99 | Samaj — society |
| 100–104 | English Verses — identity and reflection |
| 105–109 | Naye Panne — newer poems |

## Technical structure

The site is static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no dependency installation or build step. `scripts/build_content.py` parses `book.html` with BeautifulSoup and produces `js/poems-data.js`. The application then renders the archive client-side. Direct links use stable IDs such as `#poem-1` and `#poem-109`.

All poems are original works by Saumitra S. Phatak.
